answer_1.quote: The task of Chinese spelling correction (CSC) aims to correct each incorrect character in a sentence
answer_1.outputs: corrected sentences with the same length as input

answer_2.quote: we use the sentence-level correction F 1 (S-F) score as the main evaluation metric. Besides, we also report character-level correction F 1 (C-F) and sentence-level false positive rate (FPR)
